title: BLAST Premier Fall Finals 2025
description: The BLAST Premier Fall Finals 2025 brings together the top CS:GO teams from around the world to battle it out for a $425,000 prize pool. Watch as FURIA competes on home soil against the best of the best in esports.

title: ESL Pro League Season 35
description: The 35th season of the ESL Pro League will feature the top CS:GO teams competing in a month-long tournament format. As one of the longest-running tournaments in CS:GO, the ESL Pro League offers top-tier competition and a substantial prize pool.

title: VCT Americas 2025
description: VCT Americas 2025 brings together the best Valorant teams from North and South America to compete for championship points and an invitation to the Valorant Champions tournament. FURIA will face tough competition as they represent Brazil in this prestigious event.

title: IEM Katowice 2025
description: The legendary IEM Katowice returns in 2025, bringing the world's best CS:GO teams to the Spodek Arena in Poland. This prestigious tournament offers not only a massive prize pool but also the honor of lifting the trophy in one of esports' most iconic venues.

title: CBLOL Split 2 2025
description: The second split of the 2025 CBLOL (Campeonato Brasileiro de League of Legends) will see the top Brazilian League of Legends teams competing for the championship title and a spot at the World Championship. Watch as FURIA attempts to dominate the Brazilian LoL scene.

title: CBCS Elite League Season 4
description: The Brazilian Counter-Strike Championship Series (CBCS) Elite League returns for its fourth season, showcasing the best CS:GO talent in Brazil. This tournament serves as a crucial regional competition and a pathway to international events for Brazilian teams.

title: Free Fire World Series 2025
description: The Free Fire World Series 2025 brings together the top Free Fire teams from around the globe to compete for the world championship title and a massive prize pool. This event showcases the best mobile esports talent and offers intense battle royale action.

title: ESL R6 Brazil Major
description: The ESL R6 Brazil Major is a premier Rainbow Six Siege event featuring the top teams from around the world. Held in Rio de Janeiro, this tournament offers not only intense tactical FPS action but also crucial points toward the Six Invitational qualification.

title: Brazil Game Show 2025
description: Brazil Game Show 2025 is the largest gaming event in Latin America, featuring various esports tournaments across multiple games, including CS:GO, Free Fire, League of Legends, and more. This event offers Brazilian fans a chance to watch their favorite teams compete live.

title: Gamers Club Masters VII
description: The seventh edition of Gamers Club Masters brings together the best CS:GO teams from Brazil for an action-packed weekend of competition. As one of the premier regional tournaments, this event offers valuable experience and exposure for emerging talent in the Brazilian scene.

title: Copa Brasil de Free Fire 2025
description: The Copa Brasil de Free Fire is the most important national Free Fire competition, bringing together the top Brazilian teams to battle for the national title and a chance to represent Brazil at international events.

title: VCT Game Changers Brazil 2025
description: VCT Game Changers Brazil is a tournament specifically designed to create opportunities for women in the Valorant competitive scene. This event showcases the top female talent in Brazilian Valorant and helps promote diversity in esports.
